note: Web tells per area over every document of every job. tapHighlight / touchCallout: this WebKit build does not compute either property, so the value is the DECLARED one from the stylesheet source (declared:(UA default) = no rule, i.e. Safari's grey highlight / the callout). userSelect on interactive chrome (text = selectable on long-press). overscroll: html/body overscroll-behavior. rootBg: html/body backgrounds per theme (what rubber-band overscroll reveals). scrollers: vbar/hbar = classic scrollbar px (0 = overlay/none). forms: native-looking controls (appearance not none). links: tell = blue and underlined.
